heading: 종가 宗家 … 참고문헌

items.text: Respect the head of the main house as the direct descendant of the highest ancestor.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종가 宗家 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 종가는 그 친족집단 최고 조선의 직계손으로서 존경을 받고 — the head house was respected as the direct descendant of the highest ancestor.

items.text: Inherit and perform the ancestral rites of the lineage.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종가 宗家 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 종가가 조선의 제사와 가계 및 사회적 지위를 상속 — the head house inherited ancestral rites, family line, and social status.
items.conflict: Worship of the dead is forbidden; honor God alone (Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: If the head house has no son, arrange an adoption to continue its line.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종가 宗家 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 자손이 없을 때에는 양자에 의해서라도 그 가계를 계승시키려 하였다 — when there were no descendants, even by adoption, they sought to continue the line.

items.text: Help the head house when it is in economic need.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종가 宗家 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 종가가 경제적으로 어려울 경우에는 그 친족집단이 종가를 공동으로 돕는 것을 이념으로 하였다 — when the head house was in economic difficulty, the kin group commonly helping them was the ideal.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 족보 族譜 · 족보 · 2. 민간 족보의 출현

items.text: Offer ancestral rites only for the four generations up to your great-great-grandfather, except for the tablets that are not removed.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 족보 2. 민간 족보의 출현
items.quote: 불천위(不遷位)를 제외한 고조까지의 4대 봉사(奉祀)만 허용 — Only four generations of ancestral rites up to the great-great-grandfather are allowed, excluding the unmovable tablet.
items.conflict: Bible forbids worship of the dead; veneration of ancestors conflicts with exclusive worship of God (Exod. 20:3-5).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 촌수 寸數 … 참고문헌

items.text: Perform ancestor rites up to the fourth generation (great-great-grandfather), as the household principle.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 촌수 寸數
items.quote: 가정에서 지내는 조상제사는 고조까지의 4대봉사를 원칙으로 하였다. — The ancestral rites performed at home were, in principle, to serve up to the fourth generation, to the great-great-grandfather.

items.text: Keep in frequent contact with kinsmen up to the eighth degree, because you share the same ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 촌수 寸數
items.quote: 같은 고조의 자손으로 나의 세대에 있는 8촌까지의 친족원들은 조상제사를 계기로 빈번한 접촉을 유지하지만 — Descendants of the same great-great-grandfather, being relatives up to the eighth degree in my generation, maintain frequent contact on account of the ancestral rites.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족호칭

items.text: Do not address an older-generation relative by personal name; always use the proper kinship term.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족호칭
items.quote: 자기보다 윗세대의 친족원을 그의 개인명으로 호칭할 수 없고 — One cannot call a relative of an older generation by their personal name

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 항렬 行列 … 참고문헌

items.text: Give him a name that includes the generation character proper to his generation.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 항렬
items.quote: 각 세대마다 일정한 순서에 따라서 이름 글자 가운데 한 자를 공통으로 사용함으로써 — in each generation, by using one character in common in names according to a fixed order

items.text: Never take a character that an ancestor used in his name.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 항렬
items.quote: 조상의 이름으로 사용된 글자는 되풀이하지 않는 것이 원칙이다 — As a principle, do not repeat a character used in an ancestor's name.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용

items.text: Offer the ancestral rites and grave rites, and care for the graves.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 제사(祭祀)와 묘사(墓祀) 및 묘관리와 봉제사(奉祭祀) — Ancestral rites, grave rites, grave care, and serving ancestors.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment and the worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: Preside with the clan elder over the lineage's affairs and its rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 종손과 함께 대내외적인 문중일을 책임지고 이끌어나간다. — Together with the clan elder, take charge of and lead the lineage's internal and external affairs.

items.text: Represent the lineage inside and out, and lead it with the lineage heir.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 종손과 함께 대내외적인 문중일을 책임지고 이끌어나간다. — Together with the lineage heir, take charge of and lead the lineage's internal and external affairs.

items.text: As the officer, keep the lineage's property records and prepare and settle the accounts for every event.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 유사는 담당직무에 따라 1∼3명이 있는 것이 보통이다. 이들의 직무는 종손과 문장을 보필하여 문중재산에 대한 기록을 정리, 보존하는 것이다. — Usually one to three officers serve; their duty is to assist the lineage heir and clan elder, keep and preserve the records of lineage property.

items.text: Attend the annual lineage assembly and observe the order of generation and age.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 이 조직에는 같은 조상의 모든 자손들이 참가할 수 있고 항렬 · 연령에 따른 위계질서가 잘 지켜진다. — All descendants of the same ancestor may attend, and the hierarchical order by generation and age is strictly observed.

items.text: Help one another in joyful and sorrowful events.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 길흉행사에 친척끼리 상호부조하기 위한 목적으로 구성되기도 하는데 — Sometimes organized for mutual aid among relatives at happy and sad events.

items.text: Preserve the relics and records that honor a famous ancestor.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 그 조상의 위업을 나타내는 유물들을 보존하기 위한 문물보존회(文物保存會) 등이 있는 경우도 있다. — There may be a cultural property preservation society to preserve relics that display the ancestor's great achievements.
items.conflict: Veneration of ancestors through relics conflicts with the first commandment and the worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 양자 養子 · 양자 · 현황 … 참고문헌

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 족보 族譜 · 족보 · 1. 동아시아의 관찬 족보

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites and keep the family line unbroken, for on your succession the rites depend.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 족보 1. 동아시아의 관찬 족보
items.quote: 가족 가운데 한 명이 가산과 제사를 단독으로 계승하는 ‘가독상속(家督相續)’을 실시하고 있었다. — One member of the family alone succeeded to the family property and the ancestral rites, practicing 'family head succession'.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites conflict with biblical teaching that the dead cannot be contacted and worship belongs to God alone (Deut 18:10-11; 1 Tim 2:5).

items.text: Carry on the main family line without fail, for the house continues through you.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 족보 1. 동아시아의 관찬 족보
items.quote: 주로 장남이 지속적으로 가계를 잇는 본가가 가보를 작성했다. — The main house, in which the eldest son continuously succeeded the family line, compiled the genealogy.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 서얼금고법 庶孼禁錮法 · 서얼금고법 · 참고문헌

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 분재기 分財記 · 분재기 · 참고문헌

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 종손 宗孫 … 참고문헌

items.text: Represent the clan in external affairs and act as its lawful head.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종손 宗孫 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 문중을 대표하고... 대외적으로 문중을 대표하는 일 — Represent the clan and represent the clan externally.

items.text: Manage the clan's common property as its chief administrator.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종손 宗孫 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 문중 공유재산의 최고관리자로서의 임무 — duty as chief administrator of the clan's common property.

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites as first offerer and carry the responsibility to serve the ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종손 宗孫 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 제사 때 초헌관의 구실... 조상의 제사를 모실 책임 — the role of first offerer at rites, responsibility to serve ancestral rites.
items.conflict: Offering rites to ancestors conflicts with the first commandment (Exod 20:3) and the prohibition on consulting the dead (Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: Control the social conduct of the clan's members.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종손 宗孫 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 종가 사람들의 사회적 행위를 통제하는 구실 — duty to control the social behavior of the head-house people.

items.text: Make the final decision on matters resolved by the clan council.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종손 宗孫 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 문회의 의결사항들을 최종결정하는 구실 — duty to finally decide the resolutions of the clan council.

items.text: When the lineage heir is poor, cooperate as a clan to raise funds or send help.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종손 宗孫 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 종손이 빈곤할 때에는 전 문중이 협력하여 모금활동을 벌이거나 부조 — when the heir is poor, the whole clan cooperates to raise funds or give aid.

items.text: If the main house has no son to continue the line, give up a son from a branch family—even an only son—to be adopted as the heir.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종손 宗孫 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 지가의 독자라 할지라도 출계하게 하였던 것이다 — even if he were the only son, they had him go out to continue the line.

items.text: Maintain the family line and lineage tradition of the founding ancestor.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종손 宗孫 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 시조 혹은 중시조의 가계(家系)와 가통(家統)을 잇고 — continue the lineage and family tradition of the founder.

items.text: Honor the lineage heir as the head of the clan and give him due respect.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종손 宗孫 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 종손의 지위는... 최고로 존중받는 위치였다 — his position was respected as highest.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용 … 참고문헌

items.text: Manage the clan's ancestral land, run errands at all clan events, prepare the offerings for the grave rites, and pay the rent to the clan.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중
items.quote: 이들은 자신이 관리하는 토지에서 나온 수확 중 일부로 묘사의 제물을 장만하며, 약간의 소작료를 문중에 낸다. — From the harvest of the land they manage, they prepare the offerings for the grave rites and pay a small rent to the clan.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites are idolatry; serve God alone (Exod 20:3-5).

items.text: As head of the main line, manage all clan property and approve the final accounts after consulting the elders.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중
items.quote: 최종결정은 종손이 문장과 의논하여 결산을 인준한다. — The final decision is made by the head of the main line in consultation with the elders, and the accounts are approved.

items.text: Use the income from the common ancestral land to carry out the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중
items.quote: 여기에서 나오는 수입으로 봉제사를 하며 — With the income from this they perform the ancestral rites.
items.conflict: Offerings to the dead are forbidden (Deut 18:11); honor God alone.

items.text: After the grave rites and the assemblies, provide meals to honor the clan elders.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중
items.quote: 문중의 손님대접과 문중어른 대접을 하게 된다. — They entertain guests and honor the clan elders.

items.text: Those who have gone out and prospered should give financial support for the clan's events and the upkeep of its properties.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중
items.quote: 외지로 진출한 동족 중 성공한 이들이 문중행사에 투자를 하는 경우가 적지 않다. — Among the kinsmen who have gone out to the cities, those who have succeeded often invest in clan events.

items.text: Keep in frequent contact with members who have moved away, so that the ancestral house and halls may be repaired and maintained.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중
items.quote: 종손이나 유사는 위토의 관리뿐 아니라 외지의 문중원들과 빈번한 접촉을 유지하고 있다. — The head of the main line or the steward, besides managing the land, maintains frequent contact with members living away.

items.text: Render an annual account of all income and expenses to the clan assembly, with the consent of the head of the main line.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중
items.quote: 도유사가 각 위토에서의 수입과 함께 제사비용, 접대비용, 수리·보수비용들을 종손의 허락하에 보고하게 된다. — The chief steward, with the consent of the head of the main line, reports the income from the lands along with the expenses for rites, hospitality, and repairs.

items.text: Bring every sale of clan property before the general assembly and obtain its approval.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중
items.quote: 문중재산의 매매관계는 반드시 총회를 거친 다음 하게 되어 있지만 — Any sale of clan property must go through the general assembly.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 보종 補宗 … 참고문헌

items.text: Succeed to the ancestor's line and preside over his ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 보종
items.quote: 시조(始祖)의 종조(宗祧)를 승계하여 이의 제사를 주장(主掌)하는 것은 종손의 소임이며 — It is the lineage heir's duty to succeed to the founder's line and preside over his sacrifices.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with Deut 18:10-12 and Ex 20:3-5.

items.text: Preside over the grave rites for the ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 보종
items.quote: 종손이 주관하여 묘사(墓祀)를 행함 — The lineage heir presides over the grave rites.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with Deut 18:10-12 and Ex 20:3-5.

items.text: Honor the lineage heir above other clan members.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 보종
items.quote: 종손의 지위는 집단의 다른 종중원들에 비하여 높다 — The lineage heir's status is higher than that of other clan members.

items.text: Assist the main house by granting it a larger share of inherited property.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 보종
items.quote: 종중원들은 불균분한 상속제도를 통하여 보종하여 왔다고 할 수 있다 — Clan members have assisted the main house through an unequal inheritance system.

items.text: Receive guests and compile the genealogy for the clan.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 보종
items.quote: 종손은 봉제사(奉祭祀) 외에도 접빈객(接賓客) · 족보편찬 등의 종중의 대내외적인 일로 인하여 — Besides the ancestral rites, the lineage heir is responsible for receiving guests, compiling the genealogy, and other clan affairs.

items.text: Unite to assist the main house when it falls into poverty.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 보종
items.quote: 종중원들이 힘을 합하여 종가를 부조(扶助)하게 되는데 — Clan members join forces to assist the main house.

items.text: Cooperate actively when the lineage heir needs to adopt a son, even giving your eldest son.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 보종
items.quote: 종손입양의 경우는 적극적으로 협조한다 — In the case of adopting for the lineage heir, they actively cooperate.

items.text: Submit to the main house so that the whole lineage may have harmony and control.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 보종
items.quote: 지가가 종가에 예속됨으로써 공동선조에서 나온 종족 전체의 화친과 통제가 이루어지게 되었다 — Branch families were subordinated to the main house, bringing harmony and control to the whole lineage.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 호주 戶主 … 참고문헌

items.text: Submit to the household head's decisions on residence, education, custody, discipline, marriage, adoption, and the forming of a branch household.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 호주 戶主 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 가족의 거소지정권, 가족의 교육, 감호, 징계권, 가족의 혼인, 입양, 분가의 동의권 — rights to designate the family's residence, educate, guard, discipline, and consent to marriage, adoption, and branch-house formation
items.conflict: Submits family members to a legal headship that treats women and younger sons as unequal, contrary to Galatians 3:28 and mutual submission in Ephesians 5:21.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 종부 宗婦 … 참고문헌

items.text: Share with your husband the responsibility of leading the family.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종부 宗婦
items.quote: 종손과 함께 가문을 이끌어갈 책임을 맡는 파트너이다. — She is a partner who shares the responsibility of leading the family with the jongson.
items.needs_role: jongbu (宗婦, wife of the lineage heir)

items.text: When offering rites and receiving guests, ask your mother-in-law about everything.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종부 宗婦
items.quote: 종부는 제사 지내고 빈객을 맞을 때 모든 일을 시어머니에게 물어서 해야 하고 — When offering rites and receiving guests, the jongbu must ask her mother-in-law about everything.
items.needs_role: jongbu (宗婦, wife of the lineage heir)

items.text: Ask the jongbu about family matters, especially rites and guests.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종부 宗婦
items.quote: 일반 며느리들[개부(介婦)]은 종부에게 물어야 한다. — Ordinary daughters-in-law must ask the jongbu.
items.needs_role: jongbu (宗婦, wife of the lineage heir)

items.text: Do not oppose the jongbu, walk side by side with her, or sit side by side with her.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종부 宗婦
items.quote: 일반 며느리들은 종부와 맞설 수 없고 나란히 걸어서도 안 되고, 또 나란히 앉아서도 안 된다. — Ordinary daughters-in-law cannot oppose the jongbu, walk alongside her, or sit alongside her.
items.needs_role: jongbu (宗婦, wife of the lineage heir)

items.text: During the rites, follow the jongbu's directions in all things.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종부 宗婦
items.quote: 일반 며느리들은 종부의 지시를 따라야 하였다. — Ordinary daughters-in-law had to follow the jongbu's directions.
items.needs_role: jongbu (宗婦, wife of the lineage heir)

items.text: Take charge of offering the ancestral rites and receiving guests for the household.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종부 宗婦
items.quote: 제사 지내기, 손님 접대를 담당해야 하였다. — She had to take charge of offering ancestral rites and receiving guests.
items.conflict: Only God is to be worshiped; the dead do not hear or receive offerings.
items.needs_role: jongbu (宗婦, wife of the lineage heir)

items.text: Bear a legitimate son to continue the family line.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종부 宗婦
items.quote: 가계계승을 위해 적자를 생산하는 일이다. — It is the work of producing a legitimate son for the succession of the family line.
items.needs_role: jongbu (宗婦, wife of the lineage heir)

items.text: If you have no son, adopt an heir; if your husband is dead, take the lead in adopting one.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종부 宗婦
items.quote: 양자를 들일 때 이미 남편인 종자가 죽고 없는 경우에는 종부가 대표성을 갖고 입후(入後)를 주도하였다. — When adopting a son, if the husband and jongja had already died, the jongbu took the lead in adoption as the representative.
items.needs_role: jongbu (宗婦, wife of the lineage heir)

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용

items.text: Obey the clan's regulations, which set the order of conduct and the rites for ancestors and graves.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 종규에 의하여 문중원의 행위와 제사 · 묘사 등 행사의 절차가 규정된다 — The clan rules govern members' conduct and the procedure of ancestral and grave rites.

items.text: Once a year keep the grave rite for ancestors who have no household death-day rite, and so reaffirm common descent.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 1년에 한 번 행하는 묘사는 각 집에서 기제를 지내지 않는 조상들에 대한 제사를 행함으로써 공동조상의 자손임을 재강조하는 — The yearly grave rite is for ancestors without household death-day rites, reaffirming common descent.
items.conflict: Worship belongs to God alone; honor the dead without sacrifice or prayer to them.

items.text: Keep the clan's moral code; gross violations bring expulsion from the lineage.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 종규에 심히 어긋나는 행위를 하였을 때는 문중에서 축출되는 경우도 있었다 — One who grossly violated the clan rules could be expelled.

items.text: As the main-line heir, conduct the ancestral rites on behalf of the whole lineage.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 종가는 문중의 얼굴로서 봉제사뿐 아니라... — The lineage heir's house is the clan's face and offers the ancestral rites.
items.conflict: Worship belongs to God alone; the heir should lead the family in honoring ancestors without idolatrous rites.

items.text: Welcome and entertain any kinsman who comes to the main house, as the clan's host.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 접빈객(接賓客)의 구실도 한다 — It also has the duty of receiving guests.

items.text: Give the main house special support, since it bears the burden of the rites and hospitality.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 이러한 기능 때문에, 종가는 문중의 특별한 지원을 받는 것이 보통이다 — Because of this function, the main house usually receives special support from the lineage.

items.text: Own and maintain the clan's mountain land, and grant each descendant a grave site.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 문중은 문중산을 소유하여 자손들에게 묘지를 제공하여 준다 — The lineage owns a mountain and provides grave sites to descendants.

items.text: Apply the clan's common property first to the expenses of the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 공동재산은 여러 묘택에 딸려 있는 토지와 종가의 위토로 이루어져 있다. 이는 주로 제사경비를 충당하는 — The common property is land attached to graves and the heir's ritual land, used mainly for rite expenses.

items.text: When the clan sends its elders to community or literati gatherings, attend and represent it.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 이럴 때 문중에서는 어른을 참가시키며 때로는 지원금을 지급하기도 한다 — Then the lineage sends its elders to take part, and sometimes gives funds.

items.text: Build up the common fund and hold the rites on a fitting scale, so as to carry on the ancestor's standing.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 유명한 조상의 자손들은 문중재산을 적립, 행사를 성대하게 치름으로써 조상의 사회적 지위를 계승하려고 한다 — Descendants accumulate property and hold grand rites to inherit the ancestor's social standing.
items.conflict: Grand display for ancestors can become idolatrous; give God alone the glory and honor the dead soberly.

items.text: Repair and preserve the memorial pavilions and stele that honor the ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 비각을 보수, 보존한다든가 — They repair and preserve the memorial pavilions.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 문회 門會 … 참고문헌

items.text: When an urgent matter arises, summon the clan council at any time.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 문회 門會
items.quote: 급한 사항이 생기면 문장(門長)에 의하여 수시로 소집될 수 있다. — If an urgent matter arises, it may be convened at any time by the clan head.

items.text: As head of your house, attend the annual clan council and hear its reports and plans.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 문회 門會
items.quote: 참가자는 가장이나 호주이다. — Participants are household heads.

items.text: Present the financial accounts and report on the management of clan property to the council.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 문회 門會
items.quote: 유사의 결산보고와 문중재산의 관리 등에 관한 보고를 듣는다. — Hear the steward's report on finances and clan property.

items.text: Lead the clan council together with the clan head, steward, and clan elders.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 문회 門會
items.quote: 회의는 문장·종손·유사 및 문중어른에 의하여 진행된다. — The meeting is conducted by the clan head, lineage heir, steward, and elders.

items.text: Provide mutual aid to fellow clan members through the clan associations.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 문회 門會
items.quote: 문중 사람들 사이에 상호부조를 꾀하고 있다. — They aim at mutual aid among clan members.

items.text: Prepare funeral supplies and canopies and lend them to members for great occasions.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 문회 門會
items.quote: 행상도구·차일 등을 장만하여 큰일을 치를 때 빌려 준다. — Prepare funeral supplies and canopies and lend them for great occasions.

items.text: Preserve the relics of the ancestors; if they are many, form a society for their preservation.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 문회 門會
items.quote: 조상의 유물이 많을 경우 그 보존회가 성립되기도 한다. — If there are many ancestral relics, a preservation society is established.

items.text: If an ancestor is enshrined in a nearby academy, take charge of its management and report to the council.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 문회 門會
items.quote: 조상이 인근 서원에 향배(享配)되었을 경우, 서원관리를 담당하는 수도 있어 이를 위한 결산보고를 문회에 포함시키기도 한다. — If an ancestor is enshrined in a nearby academy, a manager may take charge and report to the council.
items.conflict: Conflicts with the biblical command to worship God alone (Ex. 20:3-5).

items.text: Discipline clan members who violate the clan regulations.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 문회 門會
items.quote: 종규(宗規)에 어긋난 문중 사람들을 처벌, 규제하는 기능도 하였다. — It had the function of punishing and regulating clan members who violated clan rules.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 종법 宗法 · 종법 · 내용

items.text: Keep the spirit tablets of your direct ancestors up to the great-great-grandfather in the head house, perform their anniversary rites, and serve as the first offerer at those rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종법 宗法 · 내용
items.quote: 고조부까지의 위패는 고조종의 종가에 모시며 기제사(忌祭祀)에 제사를 행한다. ... 직계조상 제사의 초헌관은 반드시 종손이 된다. — Tablets up to the great-great-grandfather are enshrined in the head house of the great-great-grandson line, and anniversary rites are performed. ... The first offerer at the rites for direct ancestors must be the chongson.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with the first commandment; worship belongs to God alone (Exod 20:3-5).

items.text: Offer the seasonal rites at the graves each year for ancestors above the great-great-grandfather, as the main lineage is responsible.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종법 宗法 · 내용
items.quote: 매환을 한 조상에게는 기제사를 올리지 않고 1년에 한 번 시제(時祭)를 지내는데, 이것은 대종이 담당한다. — For ancestors whose tablets have been buried, no anniversary rite is held; instead a seasonal rite is performed once a year, and the main line is responsible.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with the first commandment; worship belongs to God alone (Exod 20:3-5).

items.text: In the seasonal rites, serve the earlier ancestors before the later ones, following the generational order.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종법 宗法 · 내용
items.quote: 시제는 세대원리에 따라 윗대의 조상이 먼저 잡숫고 아랫대의 조상이 뒤에 잡순다. — Seasonal rites follow the generational principle: ancestors of earlier generations are served first, later ones after.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with the first commandment; worship belongs to God alone (Exod 20:3-5).

items.text: When a death occurs among your father's relatives within the mourning circle, wear mourning clothes of the grade proper to the relationship.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종법 宗法 · 내용
items.quote: 부당인 친족에서 당내친에 대해서는 상을 당하여 상복을 등급에 따라 입을 의무가 있는 것이다. — Relatives on the father's side within the mourning circle have the duty to wear mourning clothes of the proper grade when a death occurs.

items.text: Gather with your brothers when the eldest performs your father's ancestral rite.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종법 宗法 · 내용
items.quote: 아버지의 제사를 장형(長兄)이 거행할 때 형제들이 모이는 것으로 — When the eldest brother performs the father's rite, the brothers assemble.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with the first commandment; worship belongs to God alone (Exod 20:3-5).

items.text: When the head house falls into disrepair, raise the funds to repair it, as it represents the whole lineage.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종법 宗法 · 내용
items.quote: 종가가 낡고 썩어서 못 쓰게 되면 문중에서는 수리비를 조달하여 수리하게 한다. — When the head house becomes old and decayed beyond use, the lineage raises funds to have it repaired.

items.text: Elect a man of learning, age, and virtue for a set term to serve as the lineage head.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종법 宗法 · 내용
items.quote: 문장은 흔히 많이 배웠거나 나이가 많거나 덕이 높은 사람으로 일정한 임기를 두고 선출한다. — The head is elected for a set term from among men who are learned, aged, or highly virtuous.

items.text: Appoint stewards from the lineage: one to manage the common property, one to oversee the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 종법 宗法 · 내용
items.quote: 문장은 자기의 소임을 원만하게 집행하기 위하여 유사(有司)를 임명한다... 한 유사는 재산을 관리하고 한 유사는 제사를 관장한다. — The head appoints stewards... one steward manages the property and one steward oversees the rites.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 장자봉사 長子奉祀 … 참고문헌

items.text: Preside over and offer the ancestral rites as the heir of the line.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 장자봉사
items.quote: 종을 계승한 자를 종자라고 하고 조상의 제사를 주장하는 자는 종자에 한정된다 — The one who inherits the line is called the lineage heir, and only he presides over the ancestral rites.

items.text: If the eldest line has no son, take up the ancestral rites as the next in succession.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 장자봉사
items.quote: 적장자에게 아들이 없으면 중자, 중자에게 아들이 없을 때에는 첨자가 봉사하도록 규정 — If the eldest legitimate son has no son, the next son; if the next son has no son, the son of a concubine shall serve the rites.

items.text: Keep the shrine, grave land, genealogies, and ritual vessels and use them to continue the rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 장자봉사
items.quote: 분묘에 속한 1정보 이내의 금양임야와 600평 이내의 묘토인 농지·족보·제구는 호주상속인이 승계하도록 — Grave forest land within 1 jeongbo, farmland within 600 pyeong, genealogies and ritual vessels pass to the household head.

items.text: Remain filial; an unfilial heir is disqualified from the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 장자봉사
items.quote: 불효·부조에 대한 비례행위가 있어 미풍양속을 파괴한 경우 — If there be unfilial conduct or an outrage against ancestors that destroys good customs.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 당내친 堂內親 · 당내친 · 내용

items.text: Hold ancestral rites for four generations, and once a year at the grave for ancestors beyond them.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 당내친 堂內親 · 당내친 · 내용
items.quote: 고조까지 사대만 봉사하고 그 이상의 조상은 1년에 한 번 묘에서 제사를 지내라고 한다. — Hold rites for four generations, and at the grave once a year for ancestors beyond them.
items.conflict: Offering food and prayers to the dead conflicts with Deut. 18:10–12 and the first commandment.

items.text: Preside over the ancestral rites and manage the land set apart for them.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 당내친 堂內親 · 당내친 · 내용
items.quote: 제사를 주재하는 종손이 비록 소유자는 아니어도 관리는 하였다. — The heir who presides over the rites managed them, though he was not the owner.
items.conflict: Offering food and prayers to the dead conflicts with Deut. 18:10–12 and the first commandment.

items.text: Set aside land or goods for the ancestral rites, so that the burden does not fall on the lineage heir alone.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 당내친 堂內親 · 당내친 · 내용
items.quote: 후손들은 제사를 위해 별도의 재산을 마련하였는데, 이를 ‘위토(位土)’, ‘제위토’라고 하였으며 — Descendants set aside property for the rites, called 'wito' or 'jewito'.
items.conflict: Offering food and prayers to the dead conflicts with Deut. 18:10–12 and the first commandment.

items.text: Find and tend the graves of ancestors whose tombs are lost, and keep their rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 당내친 堂內親 · 당내친 · 내용
items.quote: 조상 현창은 망실된 분묘의 발견과 제사의 지속으로 수행되었다. — Honoring ancestors was done by finding lost graves and continuing the rites.
items.conflict: Offering food and prayers to the dead conflicts with Deut. 18:10–12 and the first commandment.

items.text: Give the inheritance meant for ancestral rites to the eldest son and grandson, even at the cost of daughters and younger sons.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 당내친 堂內親 · 당내친 · 내용
items.quote: 재산 상속에서 적장자가 우대를 받아 딸과 중자들은 배제 내지 차별을 받았다. — In inheritance the eldest son was favored, while daughters and younger sons were excluded or discriminated against.
items.conflict: This partiality conflicts with Scripture's call to do justice and not show favoritism (cf. Deut. 21:15–17; James 2:1).

items.text: Keep and publish the genealogy to confirm kinship and bind the lineage.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 당내친 堂內親 · 당내친 · 내용
items.quote: 친족 여부를 확인하는 족보의 간행은 그 전제였다. — Publishing the genealogy to confirm kinship was its prerequisite.

items.text: Honor the ancestors whose tablets are not removed by holding their rites as a public occasion.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 당내친 堂內親 · 당내친 · 내용
items.quote: 가묘에서 영구적으로 제향을 누리는 불천위(不遷位)에 대한 제사는 일족의 범위를 넘어서 지역 단위의 행사였다. — Rites for ancestors permanently honored in the shrine became events beyond the lineage, at the regional level.
items.conflict: Offering food and prayers to the dead conflicts with Deut. 18:10–12 and the first commandment.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 오복 五服 … 개설

items.text: Wear mourning clothes of the degree that corresponds to the closeness of your blood relationship with the deceased.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 오복 五服 … 개설
items.quote: 망자와의 혈통관계의 원근에 따라 다섯 가지로 구분되는 유교의 상복제도 — the Confucian mourning garment system, divided into five according to the closeness of the blood relationship with the deceased.

items.text: Wear three-year mourning for a parent who has died.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 오복 五服 … 개설
items.quote: 부모 3년상에 대해 여러 문헌에 보인다 — the three-year mourning for parents appears in several documents.

items.text: Wear mourning for your husband who has died.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 오복 五服 … 개설
items.quote: 부모와 남편의 복상제도가 있었다 — there were mourning systems for parents and husbands.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 족보 族譜 · 족보 · 4. 조선 후기의 족보

items.text: Record in the family genealogy your parents' dates of death and the places of their burial, so that the family can keep the death anniversaries and the grave rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 족보 4
items.quote: 사망 월일과 묘지 위치 정보는 제삿날인 기일을 공시하고 선영에서의 묘제를 함께하기 위한 기록이다 — The death dates and burial locations were recorded to announce the death anniversaries and join in the grave rites.

items.text: Preside over the ancestor rites: observe the death anniversaries and offer the grave rites on behalf of the patrilineal descendants.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 족보 4
items.quote: 부계 남성이 선조의 제사를 주관하게 되었음 — It came about that a male in the patrilineal line presided over the ancestor rites.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is forbidden; worship God alone and remember the dead without sacrifice.

items.text: When arranging a marriage for your child, study the genealogies to know the other family's lineage and standing before agreeing to the match.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 족보 4
items.quote: 혼사를 성립시키기 위해서는 족보에 등재되는 인물들과 그 자녀들의 인신 정보를 훤히 꿰뚫고 있는 보학의 발달이 요구되었다 — To establish a marriage, knowledge of genealogy that thoroughly grasped the personal information of those recorded was required.
items.conflict: Do not marry for status or favoritism; God shows no partiality.

items.text: In the genealogy, list only the children of your legal wife as full members; a son by a concubine may be entered only with his lower status noted.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 족보 4
items.quote: 적자녀에 한해서 등재되었으며... 첩의 자식인 서얼은 신분을 밝히고 등재될 수 있었다 — Only legitimate children were registered... the son of a concubine could be registered with his status made clear.
items.conflict: All children, whatever their birth, are equally valued and loved by God; no second-class children in Christ.

items.text: If the legitimate line has no son, adopt an heir to continue the lineage and keep the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 족보 4
items.quote: 종손이나 장손이 대를 이을 적자가 끊어져 계자(系子)를 들이는 등의 여러 가지 이유로 — For reasons such as the legitimate son who would succeed the line of the lineage heir being cut off and an adopted son being brought in.
items.conflict: Adoption is permissible, but not as a means to offer sacrifices to the dead.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도

items.text: Give your widowed sister a home with you until she remarries, even after your parents have died.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 남편을 사별한 과부는 그 시가에 머무르지 않고 친정부모가 사망한 뒤라도 재가할 때까지 오라버니댁에서 머무를 수가 있었으며 — A widow who lost her husband could stay not at her in-laws' but at her elder brother's house until remarriage, even after her parents died.

items.text: Even if you remarry, keep your children by your first husband with you and see to their education, even against your new husband's wishes.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 전남편의 자식을 데리고도 재혼할 수 있었을 뿐만 아니라, 재가한 남편집에서 그 남편의 반대에도 불구하고 전남편의 자식을 공부시킬 수 있었으며 — She could remarry taking her former husband's children, and even in her new husband's house, against his opposition, she could have her former husband's children educated.

items.text: Divide your inheritance equally among your sons and daughters without favor.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 재산상속에서도 아들 · 딸의 차별이 없었으며 — In property inheritance there was no discrimination between sons and daughters.

items.text: If you have no son of your own, adopt a son from among your brothers' children, from your own clan, or an abandoned child under three.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 아들이 없으면 형제의 아들, 동종의 아들, 세 살 이전에 버려진 아이 등을 양자로 삼는 것으로 되어 있다 — It was stipulated that if there was no son, one should adopt a brother's son, a son of the same clan, or an abandoned child under three.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 가례 家禮 · 가례 · 참고문헌

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 섭사 攝祀 … 참고문헌

items.text: Preside over the ancestral rites as the rightful heir, according to propriety and law.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 섭사 攝祀
items.quote: 적장자가 정당한 제사 주재자이다 — The eldest legitimate son is the rightful presider over the rites.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is idolatry; worship God alone.

items.text: When the heir is a minor, act in his place and offer the ancestral rites until he comes of age.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 섭사 攝祀
items.quote: 적장자가 어려서 제사를 주재할 수 없을 때 그의 삼촌 등이 섭사하였다 — When the eldest legitimate son was too young to preside, his uncle acted as substitute.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is idolatry; worship God alone.

items.text: If the heir is ill, act in his place and offer the ancestral rites until he recovers.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 섭사 攝祀
items.quote: 적장자가 질병 등인 경우는 그의 아우 등이 대행하였다 — When the eldest legitimate son was ill, his younger brother acted for him.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is idolatry; worship God alone.

items.text: Yield the ancestral rites to the adopted heir once he is instituted, for your service was only temporary.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 섭사 攝祀
items.quote: 형망제급에 따른 중자의 봉사는 임시적인 섭사로 인정되었다 — The second son's service under 'elder brother dies, younger brother succeeds' was recognized as temporary substitute.

items.text: Yield the ancestral rites to the adopted heir; your acting as head wife is only as substitute.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 섭사 攝祀
items.quote: 계후자(繼後子)가 제사 주재자로, 총부는 섭사로 인정받았다 — The adopted heir was the presider; the head wife was recognized as substitute.

items.text: Once installed as heir, preside over the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 섭사 攝祀
items.quote: 입후하여 양자가 제사를 모실 때까지의 섭사 — substitute until an adopted son is installed to serve the rites.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is idolatry; worship God alone.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도

items.text: Keep the ancestral rites, for they are the clan's foremost duty; attend and contribute, lest you be fined.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 조상의 제사는 조선시대의 문중이 담당한 가장 중요한 기능 — Ancestral rites were the most important function of the Joseon clan.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: Help one another at funerals and weddings.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 길흉사의 협조 — mutual help in funerals and weddings.

items.text: Educate the children of the clan.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 자녀교육 — education of children.

items.text: Respect the head of the clan.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 종손과 문장에 대한 존경 — respect for the lineage heir and the clan head.

items.text: Respect the lineage heir.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 종손과 문장에 대한 존경 — respect for the lineage heir and the clan head.

items.text: Respect elder generation and age.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 항렬과 연령의 존중 — respect for generation order and age.

items.text: Practice filial piety.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 효제(孝悌) — filial piety and brotherly love.

items.text: Love your brothers and sisters with brotherly love.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 효제(孝悌) — filial piety and brotherly love.

items.text: Encourage one another in virtue and correct one another's faults.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 덕업상권(德業相勸), 과실상규(過失相規) — mutual encouragement in virtue, mutual correction of faults.

items.text: Carry on the family line, for succession is through sons.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 아들에 의한 가계계승사상 — family succession through sons.

items.text: Obey the clan head and lineage heir in managing shared property.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 문장과 종손 또는 문중의 연장자의 지시 · 감독하에서 — under the direction and supervision of the clan head, lineage heir, or elders.

items.text: When adopting an heir, let the agnatic kin decide, not the wife's kin.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 처 쪽의 참여는 제거되고 남편 쪽 친족의 결정만으로 양자가 행하여졌다 — the wife's participation was removed and adoption was decided only by the husband's kin.
items.conflict: Excluding the wife's kin from family decisions conflicts with mutual submission in marriage (Eph. 5:21).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 가례 家禮 … 의의 및 평가

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 적장자 상속 嫡長子相續 … 참고문헌

items.text: Offer the family ancestral rites permanently, as the heir of the main line.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 적장자 상속
items.quote: 가제의 제사자는 적장자손이 영구적으로 승계한다 — the one who offers the family sacrifice is succeeded permanently by the eldest legitimate son's descendant.
items.conflict: Exodus 20:3-5; Deuteronomy 18:10-12: no worship or prayer to the dead.

items.text: Appoint your successor according to the lawful order, always preferring the eldest legitimate son and his line.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 적장자 상속
items.quote: 봉사는 적장자손에 의하여 승계하여야 하며 — succession to the ancestral rites must be by the eldest legitimate son's line.

items.text: If the heir is blind, executed, exiled, disabled, dissolute, unfilial, or rebellious, or his birth mother remarried, set him aside and appoint the next.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 적장자 상속
items.quote: 폐적 사유는 맹인·주사 및 유배 등의 처형, 폐질, 품행불량, 불효... 등 — grounds for disinheritance: blindness, execution, exile, disability, bad conduct, unfiliality...

items.text: Be filial, for unfilial conduct forfeits your right to the succession.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 적장자 상속
items.quote: 불효... 승계를 감당할 수 없는 부득이한 사정 — unfiliality... an unavoidable circumstance making one unfit for the succession.

items.text: Honor the eldest legitimate son as heir of the house and line.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 적장자 상속
items.quote: 적장자손을 존중하는 의식... '맏이'... 종가 — the consciousness of honoring the eldest legitimate son's descendant, from the word 'firstborn' to the head family.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용

items.text: Consult the head of the house respectfully on all matters, great or small.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 항상 공손한 태도로 가장의 자문을 구하는 — always seek the head's advice respectfully.

items.text: Obey the head's commands and authority, and treat him with special respect.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 명령 및 권위에 복종하고 가장을 특별히 대우할 것이 요구되었다. — obey his commands and authority and treat him specially.

items.text: Strictly control your family and supervise them so they do not break the law; bear responsibility for their offenses.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 가족원이 범법행위를 하지 않도록 주의·감독할 의무가 있어 — have a duty to supervise and watch so family members do not commit crimes.

items.text: Arrange your children's marriages at the proper time, and do not let a daughter remain unmarried past thirty.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 자녀를 적시에 혼인시킬 의무 — duty to marry children in due time.

items.text: Manage the family property, provide for the family, and oversee division, adoption, and the marriage, education, and discipline of the children.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 가산(家産)을 관리하며 가족의 부양·분가·입양, 자녀의 혼인·교육·징계 등의 사법적(私法的)인 통제권이 인정되었다. — manage household property, support the family, division, adoption, children's marriage, education, discipline.

items.text: Preside over the ancestral rites of the house.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 조상의 제사를 주재하고 — preside over ancestral rites.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites are forbidden; worship God alone.

items.text: Represent the family before the state; receive and convey official orders on its behalf.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 공법상 한 가족의 대표자 — representative of a family in public law.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 입후성문 立後成文 … 참고문헌

items.text: If you have no son, adopt an heir to continue the family line and its ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 입후성문
items.quote: 조상의 제사를 중시하는 유교적 규범 아래에서 종가나 가계의 계승은 중요한 일이었다 — Under the Confucian norm valuing ancestral rites, succession of the main line or family line was important.

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites for the family's ancestors, as the one adopted to continue the line.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 입후성문
items.quote: 입후하는 일에 신중하였던 것은 봉사하는 일은 물론이고 — They were careful about adoption because of serving ancestors, of course.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with the first commandment; God alone is to be worshiped.

items.text: Attest and approve the adoption of an heir to ensure the succession is recognized by the family.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 입후성문
items.quote: 주는 자, 문장(門長), 증인, 필집...의 착함... 수결 등이 기재되며 — The giver, the clan head, witnesses, the scribe... signed and sealed the document.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용 … 참고문헌

items.text: Wear mourning clothes appropriate to your degree of kinship, and keep them on until the mourning period ends.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 여자의 상복은 대수장군(大袖長裙) · 개두(蓋頭) · 포총(布總) · 계(筓) · 수질(首絰) · 요질(腰絰) · 교대(絞帶) · 상장(喪杖) · 구(屨)를 갖추어 입는 것이다. — A woman's mourning clothes are worn with the full set: long-sleeved jacket and long skirt, head covering, cloth hairband, hairpin, headband, waistband, belt, staff, and shoes.

items.text: As chief mourner, put on mourning dress and hold the seongbok rite.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 남녀 상주들은 성복을 하여 상복으로 갈아 입은 다음 성복제를 올린다. — Male and female chief mourners put on mourning dress and then hold the seongbok rite.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도

items.text: Use the generation character (항렬자) assigned to your generation, so that elder and younger are clearly distinguished within the clan.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 항렬자의 사용은 종족내의 세대를 표시함으로써 종족인 사이에 동배 또는 존속 · 비속을 뚜렷하게 하려는 취지 — The purpose of using generation characters is to clearly distinguish same generation or superior and inferior among clan members.

items.text: Divide the family property equally among sons and daughters, making no distinction.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 가산을 아들 · 딸 구별없이 균분 상속하는 고려시대 — In Goryeo, family property was inherited equally between sons and daughters without distinction.

items.text: Do not take a spouse of the same surname and same ancestral seat (동성동본).
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 조선시대에 와서는 동성불혼(同姓不婚)이라는 특징... 실제로는 동성동본불혼만 지켜졌을 뿐 — In Joseon, same-surname marriage was prohibited... actually only same-surname same-origin marriage was avoided.
items.conflict: Adds a marriage restriction not found in Scripture; biblical law forbids only close blood relations, not same surname.

items.text: Keep the ancestor rites (제사) and pass them on to your descendants.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 재산과 제사의 상속, 외손봉사 등 여러 측면에서 커다란 변화가 발생하는데 — Great changes occurred in inheritance of property and ancestor rites, and serving ancestors through daughters' descendants.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with the first commandment; the dead cannot be served or worshiped.

items.text: Even if you are descended through a daughter, you must keep the ancestor rites for that line.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 외손봉사 — serving ancestors through daughters' descendants.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with the first commandment; the dead cannot be served or worshiped.

items.text: If you have no son, adopt a son to carry on the ancestral rites and the family line.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 양자에 있어서의 종가사상의 대두 — In adoption, the rise of the main-line ideology.
items.conflict: Adoption for the sake of ancestor worship is rooted in forbidden rites; adoption itself is not required by Scripture for this purpose.

items.text: As the heir of the main line, preside over the ancestor rites and keep the lineage unbroken.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 친족제도
items.quote: 종가사상의 대두 — the rise of the main-line ideology.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with the first commandment.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 경국대전 經國大典 · 경국대전 · 참고문헌

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 서얼금고법 庶孼禁錮法 · 서얼금고법 · 내용

items.text: Call your father 'father'; no one may forbid it.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 서얼금고법 · 내용
items.quote: 서얼도 아버지와 형을 아버지와 형이라 부를 수 있게 하고 이를 어기는 자는 역률로 다스린다 — let sons of concubines call father and brother father and brother, and punish violators.

items.text: Call your elder brother 'brother'; no one may forbid it.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 서얼금고법 · 내용
items.quote: 서얼도 아버지와 형을 아버지와 형이라 부를 수 있게 하고 이를 어기는 자는 역률로 다스린다 — let sons of concubines call father and brother father and brother, and punish violators.

items.text: If neither wife nor concubine bears a son, adopt an heir to carry on the family line.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 서얼금고법 · 내용
items.quote: 적 · 첩 양쪽에 모두 아들이 없을 경우에 양자를 허용하고 — if both wife and concubine have no son, allow adoption.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 분재기 分財記 · 분재기 · 내용

items.text: Agree with one another to divide the inherited property after your parents are gone, and put the division in writing.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 분재기 分財記 · 분재기 · 내용
items.quote: 화회문기는 부모 모두의 사망 뒤에 형제자매의 화회에 의하여 재산을 분배하는 문서이다 — A hwahoe document is a document by which siblings distribute property by mutual agreement after both parents have died.

items.text: Complete the three-year mourning for your parents before dividing their estate.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 분재기 分財記 · 분재기 · 내용
items.quote: 화회문기는 대개 부모의 사망 뒤 3년 상을 마친 뒤에 작성되며 — A hwahoe document is usually written after the three-year mourning following the parents' death has been completed.

items.text: While you live, divide your property among your children and record each one's share in writing, so that no dispute arises later.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 분재기 分財記 · 분재기 · 내용
items.quote: 분급문기는 재주가 살아 있을 때 자녀들에게 재산을 나누어주는 문서이다 — A bungeup document is a document by which the property owner, while alive, divides property among his children.

items.text: Give an extra portion to a son or daughter on the occasion of passing the civil exam, a birthday, marriage, illness, or the birth of a son, and to a child in particular poverty.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 분재기 分財記 · 분재기 · 내용
items.quote: 특별한 사정이란 과거급제나 생일 · 혼인 · 병치료 · 득남 등을 기념하거나 축하할 때, 특별히 빈곤하거나 기특한 사람이 있을 때 — Special circumstances include passing the civil exam, birthdays, marriages, treatment of illness, or the birth of a son, or when someone is especially poor or deserving.

items.text: Keep the inherited property within the bloodline; do not allow it to pass to anyone outside the family.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 분재기 分財記 · 분재기 · 내용
items.quote: 분재기를 작성하는 목적은 조상의 유산이 혈족 이외의 타인에게 전계(傳係)되는 것과 상속 및 분배 뒤의 논란과 이의를 방지하는 데 있었다 — The purpose of writing a bunjae-gi was to prevent ancestral property from passing to persons outside the bloodline and to prevent disputes after inheritance.

items.text: Set aside provision for the ancestral rites and for the grave keeper before dividing the rest of the inheritance.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 분재기 分財記 · 분재기 · 내용
items.quote: 공동의 일인 조상관계 · 종가관계, 즉 봉사(奉祀)와 묘지기[墓直] 등을 먼저 적고 — Common matters such as ancestor relations and head-family relations, that is, ancestral rites and grave keeper, are recorded first.
items.conflict: veneration of ancestors as spirits; cf. Deut 18:10-12, Luke 16:19-31

items.text: If more property is found after the first division, divide it again by mutual agreement and record it.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 분재기 分財記 · 분재기 · 내용
items.quote: 부모 생전에 분배하고 남은 재산 또는 화회분배한 뒤에 나타난 재산도 다시 화회분배하고 문서를 작성하는 경우도 있다 — Property remaining after division during the parents' lifetime, or property appearing after a hwahoe division, is also divided again by hwahoe and documented.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 중자봉사 衆子奉祀 … 참고문헌

items.text: If there is no eldest son or grandson, a younger son must take up the ancestral rites for father and ancestors and succeed the family line.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 중자봉사 衆子奉祀
items.quote: 장자가 아닌 차자 이하가 부조(父祖)의 제사를 받들고 종통을 계승하는 가족제도. — A family system where a son other than the eldest performs ancestral rites for father and ancestors and succeeds the clan line.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: The legitimate eldest son and his descendants must inherit the ancestral rites and the family line.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 중자봉사 衆子奉祀
items.quote: 종법에 따르면 종통과 조상의 제사는 적장자손이 계승하도록 되어 있는 것이므로 — According to clan law, lineage and ancestral rites are to be inherited by the eldest son's descendants.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: If the eldest son has no son or grandson, his younger brother by the same mother must take up the ancestral rites in order of age.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 중자봉사 衆子奉祀
items.quote: 적장자나 적장손이 없는 경우에 한하여 적장자의 동모제, 즉 중자가 장유의 서열에 따라 봉사자가 되도록 규정하고 있다. — If there is no legitimate eldest son or grandson, the same-mother younger brother of the eldest son becomes the ritual heir according to age.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: Even if a younger son becomes the ritual heir, his own legitimate eldest son must succeed him, not another son.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 중자봉사 衆子奉祀
items.quote: 그 중자의 계승자는 중자의 중자가 아니라 중자의 적장자이어야 하므로 — his successor must be the second son's own legitimate eldest son, not the second son's second son.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; worship belongs to God alone.
items.needs_role: eldest son of the second son

items.text: If a married eldest son dies without a son, the clan must adopt a posthumous heir for him to continue his lineage and ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 중자봉사 衆子奉祀
items.quote: 일단 결혼하면 세대에 계승되므로 아들이 없더라도 계사, 즉 사후 양자를 들여서 종통을 계승해야 하므로 — Once married, the line must be continued through generations; so even if no son, one must adopt a posthumous heir to continue the lineage.
items.conflict: Posthumous adoption to secure an heir for ancestor veneration makes lineage an ultimate concern; Christians adopt out of love, not to perpetuate ancestor rites.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 양자 養子 · 양자 · 내용

items.text: As the heir, carry on the family line and perform the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 양자 養子 · 양자 · 내용
items.quote: 양자는 장손으로서 위계를 보장받고 가계계승과 제사를 책임지게 되었다 — As the eldest grandson, he was guaranteed rank and made responsible for family succession and ancestral rites.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is forbidden (Deut 18:10-12)

items.text: Mourn your adoptive father and mother with the full three-year mourning.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 양자 養子 · 양자 · 내용
items.quote: 『경국대전(經國大典)』에 수양자는 양부와 양모상을 당해서 재최(齊衰) 삼년상을 치루도록 명시되어 있다 — Gyeongguk daejeon requires a three-year mourning for adoptive parents.

items.text: As a child of that house, fulfill a son's duties and enjoy his rights.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 양자 養子 · 양자 · 내용
items.quote: 양자는 그 집안의 자식으로서 권리를 누리면서 의무를 이행해야 하기 때문이었다 — As a child of that household, he had to enjoy rights and fulfill duties.

items.text: When your adoptive father lies ill, go to him and attend him.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 양자 養子 · 양자 · 내용
items.quote: 외방에 근무하는 양부가 와병 중일 때... 양자에게 문병할 수 있도록 휴가를 주었다 — When an adoptive father stationed away fell ill, leave was granted for the adopted son to visit him.

items.text: Remain in your own house to succeed your father; you are not to be adopted out.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 양자 養子 · 양자 · 내용
items.quote: 장자는 양자가 될 수 없었다 — The eldest son could not become an adopted son.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 서얼금고법 庶孼禁錮法 · 서얼금고법 · 내용

items.text: Do not give your son born of a concubine the same standing as your wife's sons; limit his office and inheritance according to law.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 서얼금고법 庶孼禁錮法 · 서얼금고법 · 내용
items.quote: 문 · 무 2품 이상의 양첩 자손은 정3품, 천첩 자손은 정5품에 한하고... 한정해 서용한다 — Limit the sons of a concubine: if the father is of rank 2 or higher, they may rise only to rank 3 or 5.
items.conflict: Discrimination based on birth violates the equality of all persons before God (Deut 10:17-18; Gal 3:28).

items.text: Preserve for your wife's sons the full inheritance and office; let not the sons of a concubine encroach on their rights.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 서얼금고법 庶孼禁錮法 · 서얼금고법 · 내용
items.quote: 여러 처의 소생간의 상속 문제를 둘러싼 분쟁이 심각한 문제로 부수되어 — Disputes over inheritance among children of different wives became a serious problem.
items.conflict: The practice of favoring one group of children over another based on the mother's status conflicts with impartial love and justice (Jas 2:1-9).

items.text: Take only one wife; any other woman you take is a concubine, not your wife, and her children are inferior.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 서얼금고법 庶孼禁錮法 · 서얼금고법 · 내용
items.quote: 일처주의는 한 사람의 처 외는 모두 첩으로 규정하였다 — The principle of one wife: all but one woman are defined as concubines.
items.conflict: Concubinage as a parallel relationship is adultery and polygamy, violating God's design for marriage (Matt 19:4-6).
