items.text: Obey your parents; do not be disobedient to them.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 조선적 향약
items.quote: 부모불순자(父母不順者) 외 6항목 — those disobedient to parents, and six other items

items.text: Live in harmony with your relatives; do not be quarrelsome.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 조선적 향약
items.quote: 친척불목자(親戚不睦者) 외 16항목 — those not in harmony with relatives, and sixteen other items

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 연구 성과와 의의

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 봉사 奉祀 · 봉사 · 내용

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites to father, grandfather, and great-grandfather (or fewer according to rank), as the heir of the main line.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 봉사 奉祀 · 내용
items.quote: 3대인 증조부모까지, 7품 이하는 2대인 조부모까지, 평민은 1대인 부모만 — up to great-grandparents, up to grandparents, only parents.

items.text: Adopt a son from the same patrilineal clan to become your heir and continue the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 봉사 奉祀 · 내용
items.quote: 첩자마저 없으면 입후하도록 하였다 — if even no son by concubine, one must adopt an heir.
items.conflict: ancestor worship

items.text: If your eldest brother has no son, take over the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 봉사 奉祀 · 내용
items.quote: 아우가 제사를 모시는 형망제급 — a younger brother serves the rites, brother dead, younger brother succeeds.

items.text: If no legitimate son remains, a son by a concubine must take up the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 봉사 奉祀 · 내용
items.quote: 첩자가 제사를 모셨고 — a concubine's son served the rites.

items.text: If there is no son, a daughter and her son may serve the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 봉사 奉祀 · 내용
items.quote: 아들이 없는 경우에는 딸과 외손이 제사를 지내는 외손 봉사가 일반적이었다 — when there was no son, daughter and outer grandson generally served the rites.

items.text: Give the son who bears the ancestral rites a larger share of the inheritance, as the law provides.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 봉사 奉祀 · 내용
items.quote: 승중자에게는 중자녀보다 5분의 1을 더 주도록 — give the heir one-fifth more than the other children.
items.conflict: ancestor worship

items.text: Honor and respect the heir who carries the ancestral rites as the center of the family.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 봉사 奉祀 · 내용
items.quote: 봉사자는 제사를 단독으로 승계하고... 존중받았다 — the heir singly succeeds to rites and is respected.

items.text: Hold the death-anniversary rite for departed ancestors each year.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 봉사 奉祀 · 내용
items.quote: 기일제(忌日祭)를 가장 중시하였으며 — most stressed the death-anniversary rite.

items.text: Hold the grave rite at the tomb of departed ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 봉사 奉祀 · 내용
items.quote: 묘제를 가장 중시하였으며 — most stressed the grave rite.

items.text: Offer the New Year and harvest-festival rites to ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 봉사 奉祀 · 내용
items.quote: 추석에 모시는 절사(節祀) 및 정월 초하루에 모시는 연시제(年始祭)로 제한 — limited to harvest rite and New Year rite.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 내훈 內訓 · 내훈 · 의의와 평가 … 참고문헌

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 친족 親族 · 친족 · 현대의 친족관계

items.text: Help your paternal kin in daily life, work, and household tasks.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 현대의 친족관계
items.quote: 사교 · 생산 · 가사협조 · 의례적 관계 등 모든 기능을 부계친이 담당한다. — The paternal kin take charge of all functions—social, productive, household cooperative, and ceremonial.

items.text: Render ritual service and respect to the elder generation.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 현대의 친족관계
items.quote: 윗세대에 대하여는 의례적 관계, 동세대에 대하여는 사교의 기능이 활발하여지는 경향이 있다. — Toward the elder generation, ritual relationships tend to be active; toward the same generation, social functions are active.

items.text: Keep close ties with your near kin; do not let them weaken.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 현대의 친족관계
items.quote: 원친과는 친족의식이 약화되어가고 있지만 근친과는 친족의 중요성이 그대로 유지되고 있다. — Consciousness of kinship weakens with distant kin, but the importance of close kin is maintained.

items.text: Keep active contact with your natal family after marriage.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 현대의 친족관계
items.quote: 시가 쪽 친족보다 친정 쪽 친족이, 그리고 혈연이 먼 친족보다 가까운 친족간에 접촉이 활발하다. — Contact is more active with the wife's natal kin than with the husband's kin, and with closer kin than with more distant blood kin.

items.text: Help your siblings economically when they are in need.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 현대의 친족관계
items.quote: 친정 쪽에서는 형제자매까지이다. — on the wife's side, up to siblings.

items.text: Help your first cousins economically; be ready to share burdens.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 현대의 친족관계
items.quote: 시가에서는 4촌 정도까지이고 — on the husband's side, up to first cousins.

items.text: Maintain social and ceremonial ties with kin beyond the circle of economic help.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 현대의 친족관계
items.quote: 그러나 사교나 의례적 관계에 있어서는 이보다 훨씬 그 범위가 확대된다. — But in social and ceremonial relationships, the range extends much farther than this.

items.text: Do not let geographical distance keep you from ancestral rites to your ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 현대의 친족관계
items.quote: 의례적 관계에 있어서는 지리적 거리의 영향을 그다지 받지 않는다. — ceremonial relationships are little affected by geographical distance.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites conflict with exclusive worship of God (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: Participate in her husband's family's ancestral rites and honor his ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 현대의 친족관계
items.quote: 집안의 유지와 관련이 있는 제사에 있어서는 시가 쪽 친족과의 관계가 강하다. — In ancestral rites related to maintaining the family, the relationship with the husband's kin is strong.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites conflict with exclusive worship of God (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: As lineage heir, preside over the ancestral rites for your clan.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 현대의 친족관계
items.quote: 중심 ... 종손 주요기능 ... 제사 — center ... the lineage heir; main functions ... ancestral rites.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites conflict with exclusive worship of God (Exodus 20:3-5).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 향약의 종류

items.text: Keep your proper station; do not despise or overstep those above you, so that order may be preserved.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약의 종류
items.quote: 상하간의 수분을 강조하여 신분제 질서를 유지 — “They sought to maintain the status order by emphasizing the duty of each to keep his place between superior and inferior.”

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용

items.text: Mourn him for three years in the unhemmed sackcloth of the deepest mourning (chamchoe).
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용
items.quote: 아버지 상을 당했을 때 — when one has met the father's death

items.text: Mourn her for three years in hemmed sackcloth (jacheo).
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용
items.quote: 아들이 어머니 상을 당했을 때 — when a son meets his mother's death

items.text: Mourn him for three years in the unhemmed sackcloth of deepest mourning.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용
items.quote: 아내가 남편의 상을 당했을 때 — when a wife meets her husband's death

items.text: Mourn her for one year without using a staff.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용
items.quote: 남편이 아내의 상을 당했을 때 — when a husband meets his wife's death

items.text: Mourn your mother-in-law for three years.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용
items.quote: 며느리가 시어머니의 상을 당했을 때 — when a daughter-in-law meets her mother-in-law's death

items.text: Mourn your eldest son for three years.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용
items.quote: 어머니가 맏아들의 상을 당했을 때 — when a mother meets her eldest son's death

items.text: Mourn him for one year with a staff.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용
items.quote: 손자가 할아버지의 상을 당했을 때 — when a grandson meets his grandfather's death

items.text: Mourn your uncle or aunt for one year.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용
items.quote: 조카가 백부모나 숙부모의 상을 당했을 때 — when a nephew meets the death of his uncle or aunt

items.text: Mourn each other for nine months.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용
items.quote: 종형제, 즉 사촌의 상을 당했을 때 — when one meets the death of a cousin

items.text: Mourn your father-in-law and mother-in-law for three months.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용
items.quote: 사위가 장인 · 장모의 상을 당했을 때 — when a son-in-law meets the death of his father-in-law or mother-in-law

items.text: Mourn your eldest daughter-in-law for one year; mourn a non-eldest daughter-in-law for nine months.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용
items.quote: 시부모가 맏며느리의 상을 당했을 때 / 시부모가 맏이가 아닌 며느리의 상을 당했을 때 — when parents-in-law meet the death of the eldest daughter-in-law / when they meet the death of a non-eldest daughter-in-law

items.text: Mourn the wife as for a senior kinswoman for three years.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용
items.quote: 첩이 정실부인의 상을 당했을 때 — when a concubine meets the death of the wife
items.conflict: Concubinage is contrary to the one-flesh union of one man and one woman (Genesis 2:24; Matthew 19:5).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 불천위 不遷位 … 참고문헌

items.text: Preside over the memorial rites as head of the lineage.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 불천위 不遷位
items.quote: 종손이 주제를 하되 — the lineage heir presides
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is forbidden (Exod 20:3-5; Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: Keep the spirit tablet in the family shrine and offer the memorial rites as long as descendants remain.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 불천위 不遷位
items.quote: 불천위는 그 자손들이 있는 한 분묘와는 별도로 사당에 신위를 모시고 제사를 지낸다 — As long as descendants remain, keep the tablet in the shrine and offer rites.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is forbidden (Exod 20:3-5; Deut 18:10-12).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 사당 祠堂 · 사당 · 내용 … 참고문헌

items.text: Perform the morning salutation, the reports on going out and coming in, the new- and full-moon visits, the New Year and solstice visits, the festival tea rites, the offerings of new produce, and the announcements of family events before the spirit tablets.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 사당 祠堂 · 사당 · 내용
items.quote: 사당에서 행하는 의식으로서는 신알례·출입고·삭참·망참·정조참·동지참·속절다례·천신례·유사고가 있다 — In the shrine, the rites performed are the morning salutation, reports of going out and coming in, new- and full-moon visits, New Year and solstice visits, festival tea rites, offerings of new produce, and announcements of family events.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first and second commandments and is idolatry (Exod 20:3-5).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 사후양자 死後養子 … 참고문헌

items.text: When you have no descendant of your own, choose an heir before you die, and make your choice known, so your wife can later report it.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 사후양자 死後養子
items.quote: 아버지가 죽었다면 어머니가 관에 고한다 — If the father has died, the mother reports to the government.

items.text: When your husband dies without a lineal descendant, take the first place: adopt an heir for him so his house does not perish.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 사후양자 死後養子
items.quote: 호주가 직계비속 없이 사망한 경우 그 배우자가 1차로 선정권자가 되며 — When the household head dies without lineal descendants, his spouse becomes first selector.

items.text: If his widow will not or cannot act, you his elder kinsmen must choose an heir for the dead man.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 사후양자 死後養子
items.quote: 배우자가 없거나 또는 사후양자를 선정하지 않는다는 의사표시를 한 때는 직계존속이 이를 선정 — If the spouse is absent or refuses to select, the lineal ascendants select.

items.text: If no spouse or elder acts, let the assembled kinsmen adopt an heir for him.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 사후양자 死後養子
items.quote: 직계존속이 없으면 친족회가 이를 선정할 수 있다 — If there are no lineal ascendants, the family council may select.

items.text: When a house is already extinct, you the former head's elders must adopt an heir to revive it.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 사후양자 死後養子
items.quote: 폐가 또는 무후가를 부흥시키기 위하여 전호주의 사후양자를 선정하는 경우 전호주의 직계존속·친족회의 순위로 이를 선정한다 — To revive an extinct house, former head's lineal ascendants then family council select.

items.text: If no elder of the former head remains, the family council must choose an heir to raise the house again.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 사후양자 死後養子
items.quote: 전호주의 직계존속·친족회의 순위로 이를 선정한다 — Former head's lineal ascendants then family council select.

items.text: Do not choose a posthumous heir for a son who has been adopted out of your family; that is his new line's duty.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 사후양자 死後養子
items.quote: 생가의 직계존속은 출계자의 사후양자를 선정하지 못한다 — The biological family's lineal ascendants cannot select a posthumous heir for an out-adopted son.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 내훈 內訓 … 편찬/발간 경위

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 연구 성과와 의의

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 개설

items.text: Encourage one another in virtue and good deeds.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 · 개설
items.quote: 덕업상권 — mutual encouragement of virtue

items.text: Correct one another's faults.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 · 개설
items.quote: 과실상규 — mutual correction of faults

items.text: Show courtesy to one another in social customs.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 · 개설
items.quote: 예속상교 — mutual exchange of courtesy

items.text: Help one another in times of disaster and hardship.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 · 개설
items.quote: 환난상휼 — mutual aid in calamity

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 각 도 향약 · 동계의 운영 실례

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용

items.text: Receive the dead with rites: wear mourning garments according to your relation to the deceased.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 상복을 엄숙하게 갖추어 입는 것은 인간의 생명에 대한 존엄성을 나타내는 것으로서, 삶과 죽음의 갈림길에서 죽은 사람을 예로써 보내기 위한 산 사람들의 예의 표현방법이다.

items.text: For your father, wear the unhemmed sackcloth (chamchoe) for three years.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 참최의 상복을 입는 기간은 3년이며 그 대상은 아버지와 큰아들이다.

items.text: For your mother, wear the hemmed sackcloth (jacheo) for three years.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 자최 3년의 대상은 어머니이다.

items.text: For your eldest son, the heir of the lineage, wear unhemmed sackcloth for three years.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 참최의 상복을 입는 기간은 3년이며 그 대상은 아버지와 큰아들이다.

items.text: For your eldest son, wear hemmed sackcloth for three years.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 큰아들에 대해서도 자최 3년을 입는다.

items.text: For your husband, wear unhemmed sackcloth for three years.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 남편과 시아버지에 대해서는 참최 3년을 입고

items.text: For your father-in-law, wear unhemmed sackcloth for three years.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 남편과 시아버지에 대해서는 참최 3년을 입고

items.text: For your mother-in-law, wear hemmed sackcloth for three years.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 시어머니에 대해서는 자최 3년을 입으며

items.text: For your wife, wear hemmed sackcloth with staff for one year.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 자최 장기의 대상은 처(妻)로 상기는 1년이다.

items.text: For your grandparents, wear hemmed sackcloth without staff for one year.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 자최부장기의 대상은 할아버지, 할머니, 백숙부모(伯叔父母), 고모, 형제자매, 큰아들이 아닌 아들과 딸들, 큰며느리, 조카, 장손, 장증손, 장고손으로 상기는 1년이다.

items.text: For your uncles and aunts, wear hemmed sackcloth without staff for one year.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 자최부장기의 대상은 할아버지, 할머니, 백숙부모(伯叔父母), 고모, 형제자매, 큰아들이 아닌 아들과 딸들, 큰며느리, 조카, 장손, 장증손, 장고손으로 상기는 1년이다.

items.text: For your brothers and sisters, wear hemmed sackcloth without staff for one year.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 자최부장기의 대상은 할아버지, 할머니, 백숙부모(伯叔父母), 고모, 형제자매, 큰아들이 아닌 아들과 딸들, 큰며느리, 조카, 장손, 장증손, 장고손으로 상기는 1년이다.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 양자 養子 … 연원 및 변천

items.text: Honor your adoptive parents with the full rites due natural children, including three years of mourning when they die.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 양자 養子 … 연원 및 변천
items.quote: 양부모에 대해서 친자의 예를 갖추었는데... 양부의 상을 삼년으로 치룬 — They treated adoptive parents with the courtesy due natural children, as seen in the three years' mourning for the adoptive father.

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites of your adoptive line, since you have inherited them together with the property.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 양자 養子 … 연원 및 변천
items.quote: 재산과 함께 제사도 상속받았으며 — Inherited the ancestral rites together with the property.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration; worship belongs to God alone (Exod 20:3-5).

items.text: If you have no son, adopt a son from among your brothers' sons of the proper generation to continue your family line.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 양자 養子 … 연원 및 변천
items.quote: 아들이 없는 집안은 형제의 아들 중에서 항렬이 동일한 남아를 양자로 들였다 — A house without a son adopted a male of the same generation from among the brothers' sons.

items.text: If you have no son and do not adopt an heir, pass on your property and the duty of ancestral rites to your daughter.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 양자 養子 … 연원 및 변천
items.quote: 딸에게 재산과 제사를 상속하였고 — Gave inheritance of property and rites to the daughter.

items.text: If you have neither daughter nor adopted son, hand on your house, property, and ancestral rites to your son born of a concubine.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 양자 養子 … 연원 및 변천
items.quote: 딸도 없는 경우에야 비로소 서자에게 자신의 가계와 재산, 제사를 계승하도록 하였다 — Only when there was no daughter did they have the son of a concubine inherit the family, property, and rites.
items.conflict: Assumes concubinage; Scripture teaches one man and one woman (Matt 19:5).

items.text: Support your adoptive parents in their old age and serve them faithfully after their death.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 양자 養子 … 연원 및 변천
items.quote: 노후봉양, 사후봉사 등 ... 양자와 양부모가 ... 정을 실현 — Support in old age and posthumous service realized the bond between adopted child and parents.

items.text: If no suitable heir is found in your son's generation, adopt a son in the name of your dead son so that his line and rites continue.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 양자 養子 … 연원 및 변천
items.quote: 아들 항렬에서 이미 죽은 사람의 이름으로 입양하는 것을 백골양자라고 불렀다 — Adopting in the name of someone already dead in the son's generation was called 'white-bone adoption'.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration; the dead do not need heirs to offer rites (Heb 9:27).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 각 도 향약 · 동계의 운영 실례

items.text: Honor and serve your parents with filial piety, as the village covenant requires.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 각 도 향약 · 동계의 운영 실례
items.quote: 충효상면(忠孝相勉) — Mutual encouragement of loyalty and filial piety.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 시제 時祭 … 참고문헌

items.text: Offer the seasonal rites to your ancestors from your parents up to your great-great-grandparents on an auspicious day in the middle month of each season.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 시제 時祭 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 사시제는... 부모로부터 고조부모까지의 제사를 받드는 것으로 — offer rites to parents up to great-great-grandparents.

items.text: Offer the grave rite once a year at the tomb for your ancestors beyond the fifth generation.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 시제 時祭 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 대진된 5대조 이상의 조상을 해마다 한번 그 묘소에서 받드는 제사 — offered once a year at the tomb for ancestors beyond the fifth generation.

items.text: Offer the festival rites on New Year's Day, the first full moon, Hansik, Samjin, Dano, Yudu, Chuseok, Jungyang, and the winter solstice to your ancestors; for those below your great-great-grandparents, read no prayer and pour only one cup of wine.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 시제 時祭 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 정월 초하루·정월보름·한식... 고조부모 이하의 신위에 대해서는 독축하지 않고 술도 일헌만으로 한다 — ... read no prayer and pour one cup of wine.

items.text: Go to the tomb, cut the grass and clean the area, then burn incense and offer the sacrifice, and also sacrifice to the mountain or earth spirit.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 시제 時祭 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 자손들이 묘소에 가서 벌초를 하고... 산신 또는 토신에게도 제사를 지낸다 — descendants go to the tomb, cut grass, clean, burn incense, sacrifice, and also sacrifice to mountain or earth spirit.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 경국대전 經國大典 · 경국대전 · 내용

items.text: Preside over the family's ancestral rites and keep the prescribed sacrifices for the ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 경국대전 經國大典 · 경국대전 · 내용
items.quote: 봉사(奉祀) — ancestral rites
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is forbidden; Deut 18:10-12; worship belongs to God alone (Exod 20:3-5).

items.text: Wear mourning and observe the prescribed mourning rites for a deceased parent.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 경국대전 經國大典 · 경국대전 · 내용
items.quote: 상복 제도 — mourning system
items.conflict: Mourning is lawful, but avoid rites that treat the dead as conscious or pray for them; do not let mourning overshadow hope in Christ (1 Thess 4:13).

items.text: If you have no son, adopt an heir from among agnatic kin so that the ancestral line and rites may continue.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 경국대전 經國大典 · 경국대전 · 내용
items.quote: 입후(立後) — adoption of heir
items.conflict: Adoption is lawful, but its purpose must not be ancestor worship; the adopted son becomes a full son, and the family line is not salvific (Gal 3:28-29).

items.text: Provide an equal share of the family estate to each son and daughter; do not disinherit a child without just cause.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 경국대전 經國大典 · 경국대전 · 내용
items.quote: 자녀 균분 상속법 — law of equal inheritance division among children

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용 … 참고문헌

items.text: When your child dies before the age of twenty, wear the mourning assigned to one of the three untimely-death grades: nine months for a youth of seventeen to twenty, seven for a youth of thirteen to sixteen, and five for a child of nine to twelve.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 20세 전의 자식이 죽었을 때는 삼상(三殤)이라 하여 이에 각기 해당하는 상복을 입는다 — When a child dies before twenty, one wears the corresponding mourning for the three untimely deaths.

items.text: If your mother dies while your father is still alive, wear the one-year mourning for her, not the three-year mourning, because your father's higher standing governs.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 아버지가 살아 있을 때 어머니의 상을 당하면 기년상(1년상)을 입는 것과 같은 것이다 — When one meets the death of one's mother while one's father lives, one wears the one-year mourning.

items.text: Mourn your husband for three full years with the highest mourning grade, 참최.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 아내가 남편의 복은 참최 3년 — A wife's mourning for her husband is the three-year 참최.

items.text: Wear the one-year 장기 mourning for your deceased wife.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 남편이 아내의 복은 장기로 끝난다 — A husband's mourning for his wife ends with the one-year 장기.

items.text: Wear mourning for your adoptive mother because she bears the name mother, even though there is no blood tie.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 입양모나 숙모의 경우에는 혈친관계는 아니지만 입양부와 숙부와 혼인한 것 때문에 모라는 명의가 붙게 되므로 상복을 입는다 — For an adoptive mother or an uncle's wife, though not blood kin, because they are given the name mother through marriage, one wears mourning.

items.text: Wear mourning for your uncle's wife because she bears the name aunt through marriage, even though not a blood relative.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 입양모나 숙모의 경우에는 혈친관계는 아니지만 입양부와 숙부와 혼인한 것 때문에 모라는 명의가 붙게 되므로 상복을 입는다 — For an adoptive mother or an uncle's wife, though not blood kin, because they are given the name mother through marriage, one wears mourning.

items.text: After you marry into your husband's house, wear mourning for your natal kin one grade lower than before.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 출가한 뒤에는 시가의 사람이 되어 시가의 복을 입게 되므로 친가식구들에게는 한 등급 낮추어서 복을 입게 되는데 — After marrying out, she becomes a person of her husband's family and wears a grade lower for her natal kin.

items.text: If you are adopted into another house, lower your mourning for your birth kin by one grade, as a daughter does when she marries out.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 오복 五服 · 오복 · 내용 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 남자도 남의 집에 입양하면 딸이 시집가는 것과 같이 강복이 된다 — A man adopted into another house also lowers his mourning, like a daughter marrying out.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 사당 祠堂 · 사당 · 내용

items.text: Build the ancestor shrine before building the house.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 사당 祠堂 · 사당 · 내용
items.quote: 사당은 집을 짓기 전에 먼저 지어야 하니 — The shrine must be built before building the house.
items.conflict: Second Commandment forbids ancestor veneration.

items.text: Keep and guard the shrine that holds the spirit tablets, passing it down from generation to generation.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 사당 祠堂 · 사당 · 내용
items.quote: 사당이 있는 집은 종자(宗子)가 대대로 지켜야 하며 — The house with the shrine must be guarded by the lineage heir generation after generation.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is forbidden; worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: Enshrine the tablets of the four generations as the rule.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 사당 祠堂 · 사당 · 내용
items.quote: 사당에 4대의 신주를 일렬로 열향하여 모시는 것을 원칙으로 하였다 — The principle was to enshrine the four generations' tablets in a row in the shrine.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is forbidden.

items.text: Attach the tablets of collateral kin who died without descendants to the proper alcove.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 사당 祠堂 · 사당 · 내용
items.quote: 방친 가운데 후손이 없는 사람의 신주는 차례대로 해당 감실에 반부(班祔)하며 — Tablets of collateral kin without descendants are attached in sequence to the proper alcove.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is forbidden.

items.text: Perform rites for your secondary mother only in your private quarters, not in the main shrine, and only while you live.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 사당 祠堂 · 사당 · 내용
items.quote: 서모(庶母)는 선당에 모시지 않고 아들이 사실(私室)에서 제사를 지내되 생전에 한한다 — A secondary mother is not enshrined in the shrine; the son offers rites in his private quarters while alive.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship; secondary wife system contrary to monogamy.

items.text: Offer ancestral rites for a child who dies young only as long as the prescribed kin survive: none under eight; parents for eight to eleven; siblings for twelve to fifteen; siblings' children for sixteen to nineteen; for an adult without heirs, up to siblings' grandchildren.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 사당 祠堂 · 사당 · 내용
items.quote: 1세에서 7세까지의 죽음을 무복지상이라 하여 제사를 지내지 않는다 — Deaths from one to seven are called unwailed and no rite is offered.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration forbidden (Exod 20:3-6).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용

items.text: Wear the five-month mourning of zicui for a departed great-grandparent.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 자최 5월의 대상은 증조부와 증조모이고 — The object of the five-month zicui mourning is great-grandfather and great-grandmother.
items.conflict: No biblical command for graded mourning periods; mourning should be simple and hopeful (1 Thess 4:13).

items.text: Wear the three-month mourning of zicui for a departed great-great-grandparent.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 자최 3월의 대상은 고조부와 고조모이다 — The object of the three-month zicui mourning is great-great-grandfather and great-great-grandmother.
items.conflict: No biblical command for graded mourning periods; mourning should be simple and hopeful (1 Thess 4:13).

items.text: Wear the nine-month mourning of daegong for a departed first cousin, nephew's wife, a daughter-in-law who is not the eldest, or a grandson who is not the eldest.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 대공의 상기는 9월이며, 대상은 종형제, 종자매, 조카며느리, 큰며느리가 아닌 며느리, 장손이 아닌 손자이다 — The period of daegong is nine months; its objects are first cousins, nephew's wife, a daughter-in-law who is not the eldest, and a grandson who is not the eldest.
items.conflict: No biblical command for graded mourning periods; mourning should be simple and hopeful (1 Thess 4:13).

items.text: Wear the five-month mourning of sogong for a departed granduncle, grandaunt, great-uncle, great-aunt, brother's wife, second cousin, grandnephew, grandniece, eldest grandson's wife, or other prescribed collateral kin.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 소공의 상기는 5월이며, 그 대상은 종조부모, 종조고모, 종숙부모, 종고모, 형제의 처, 재종형제자매 — The period of sogong is five months; its objects are granduncle/grandaunt, great-uncle/great-aunt, brother's wife, second cousins, etc.
items.conflict: No biblical command for graded mourning periods; mourning should be simple and hopeful (1 Thess 4:13).

items.text: Wear the three-month mourning of sima for a departed great-granduncle, great-grandaunt, second cousin once removed, third cousin, or other prescribed distant collateral kin.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 상복 喪服 · 상복 · 내용
items.quote: 시마의 상기는 3월이다. 그 대상은 종증조부모, 종증조고모, 재종증조부모, 재종증조고모 — The period of sima is three months; its objects are great-granduncle/grandaunt, second cousins once removed, third cousins, etc.
items.conflict: No biblical command for graded mourning periods; mourning should be simple and hopeful (1 Thess 4:13).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 동성동본불혼 同姓同本不婚 … 연원 및 변천

items.text: Before marrying, verify in the genealogical records and oral tradition that you and your intended do not share a common patrilineal ancestor; if you do, refrain from marrying, however distant the kinship.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 동성동본불혼 同姓同本不婚 … 연원 및 변천
items.quote: 성과 본이 같은 남녀 사이... 혼인을 하지 않는 제도 — Between a man and a woman of the same surname and ancestral seat, marriage is not contracted.
items.conflict: Leviticus 18; 1 Corinthians 7:39

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 각 도 향약 · 동계의 운영 실례

items.text: Give mutual help for weddings and funerals.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 · 동계의 운영 실례
items.quote: 혼상부조(婚喪扶助) — mutual aid for marriages and funerals

items.text: Make funeral aid the first duty: supply what is needed for burial.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 · 동계의 운영 실례
items.quote: 상사(喪事)의 부조가 중심이었다 — funeral aid was central

items.text: Provide for the economic needs of the aged and weak.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 · 동계의 운영 실례
items.quote: 노약자에 대한 경제적 배려 — economic consideration for the aged and weak

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 기제 忌祭 … 연원 및 변천

items.text: On the anniversary of a parent's death, give full expression to your grief and conduct yourself unlike ordinary days.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 기제 忌祭 … 연원 및 변천
items.quote: 옛날 사람들은 기일에 음식을 올리는 예를 행하지 않고, 다만 슬픔을 다해 일상과 다른 모습을 보여 줄 따름이었다. — In ancient times people did not perform the rite of offering food on the death day, but simply gave full expression to sorrow and showed themselves different from ordinary days.

items.text: Perform the annual memorial rite on the death day for parents, grandparents, great-grandparents, and great-great-grandparents.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 기제 忌祭 … 연원 및 변천
items.quote: 기제사 대상을 부모, 조부모, 증조부모, 고조부모로 4대조까지 — The objects of the death-day rite are parents, grandparents, great-grandparents, and great-great-grandparents, up to the fourth generation.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites as worship of the dead; Scripture forbids consulting the dead (Deut 18:11).

items.text: On father's death anniversary, set up only the father's spirit tablet; on mother's death anniversary, set up only the mother's spirit tablet.
items.citation: EncyKorea, 기제 忌祭 … 연원 및 변천
items.quote: 아버지의 기일이라면 아버지 한 분의 신위만 설치한다. 어머니의 기일에는 어머니 한 분의 신위만 설치한다. — On the death day of the father, set up only the spirit tablet of the father; on the death day of the mother, set up only that of the mother.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites as worship of the dead; Scripture forbids consulting the dead (Deut 18:11).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 가묘 家廟 · 가묘 · 내용

items.text: As eldest legitimate son or grandson, preside over the ancestral sacrifices.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가묘 家廟 · 가묘 · 내용
items.quote: 적장자손주제(嫡長子孫主祭)의 원칙 — the principle that the eldest legitimate son or grandson presides over the sacrifices
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: Offer the ancestral rites to the generations prescribed by rank: three for senior officials, two for junior, one for commoners.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가묘 家廟 · 가묘 · 내용
items.quote: 문무관 6품 이상은 3대를, 7품 이하는 2대를, 서인들은 할아버지·할머니만을 제사지내도록 명시하였다. — It stipulated that civil and military officials of rank six or higher should sacrifice to three generations, rank seven or lower to two, and commoners only to grandfather and grandmother.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: Rise at dawn daily, go into the shrine, burn incense, and bow twice before the ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가묘 家廟 · 가묘 · 내용
items.quote: 주인이 새벽에 일어나 사당의 외문 안에 들어가 두 섬돌 중간의 향탁에 분향하고 두 번 절 — the master rises at dawn, enters inside the outer gate of the shrine, burns incense at the incense table between the two stairs, and bows twice
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: Whenever the master or mistress goes out or returns, announce it at the ancestral shrine.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가묘 家廟 · 가묘 · 내용
items.quote: 출입례는 주인이나 주부가 바깥출입을 할 때 사당에 아뢰는 것을 말한다. — The departure-and-return rite means the master or mistress reports to the shrine when going out or returning.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: Keep the regular rites on New Year, winter solstice, and the first and fifteenth of each month.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가묘 家廟 · 가묘 · 내용
items.quote: 참례는 정조(正朝)·동지·초하루·보름에 사당에 지내는 제사이다. — The assembly rite is the sacrifice offered at the shrine on New Year, winter solstice, and the first and fifteenth of each month.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: Offer the first fruits or seasonal festival foods at the shrine on Cheongmyeong, Hansik, Jungyang, and other holidays.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가묘 家廟 · 가묘 · 내용
items.quote: 천신례는 청명·한식·중양 등의 명절 때 절식을 올리는 것을 말한다. — The offering-of-new-food rite means presenting seasonal foods on holidays such as Cheongmyeong, Hansik, and Jungyang.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: Report every significant family event—posthumous office, birth of an heir, appointment, repair, or move—at the shrine.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가묘 家廟 · 가묘 · 내용
items.quote: 고유례는 집안에 무슨 일이 일어나면 사당에 고하는 것을 말한다. — The announcement rite means reporting to the shrine whenever something happens in the family.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: After mourning, refurbish the old tablets, remove those beyond four generations, and install the new tablet; also enshrine tablets of collateral kin who have no descendants.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가묘 家廟 · 가묘 · 내용
items.quote: 길제를 지낸 뒤 대가 지난 신주를 천조(遷祧)하고 새 신주를 정해진 자리에 모신다. — After the auspicious sacrifice, remove the tablets that have passed their generation and install the new tablet in its appointed place.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: Set aside one-twentieth of the fields for each niche as a ritual field, and use its produce to fund the sacrifices.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가묘 家廟 · 가묘 · 내용
items.quote: 가지고 있는 밭의 20분의 1씩을 매 감실 몫으로 떼어 제전(祭田)으로 삼고 거기에서 얻어지는 소득으로 제사의 비용을 충당한다. — Set aside one-twentieth of the fields for each niche as ritual land, and use the income to cover the cost of the sacrifices.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: In flood, fire, or theft, rescue the shrine first: carry out the spirit tablets and writings, then the vessels, and only then household goods.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가묘 家廟 · 가묘 · 내용
items.quote: 수해나 화재가 났을 때, 그리고 도둑이 들었을 때에는 제일 먼저 사당을 구한다. 신주와 유서를 옮기고 난 다음 제기를 옮기며, 가재(家財)는 그 다음에 옮긴다. — In case of flood, fire, or theft, first rescue the shrine; after moving the spirit tablets and writings, move the vessels, and after that the household goods.
items.conflict: Treating ancestor tablets as sacred objects conflicts with the second commandment and worship of God alone.

items.text: If the shrine burns, mourn for three days; if a spirit tablet burns, make a new one, enshrine it, and offer an announcement rite.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 가묘 家廟 · 가묘 · 내용
items.quote: 사당이 불에 탔을 경우에는 3일 동안 곡을 한다고 하며, 신주가 불에 타버렸을 때에는 새로 만들어 모신 다음 분향하여 고제(告祭)를 올린다고 한다. — If the shrine burns, they mourn for three days; if the spirit tablet burns, they make a new one, enshrine it, and offer an announcement sacrifice.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 각 도 향약 · 동계의 운영 실례

items.text: Congratulate them on their happy occasions and console them in their sad ones.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 각 도 향약 · 동계의 운영 실례
items.quote: 길흉조경(吉凶弔慶) — congratulate and console on fortune and misfortune

items.text: Come to their aid in times of trouble, supplying what is needful.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 각 도 향약 · 동계의 운영 실례
items.quote: 환난상구(患難相求) — mutual aid in distress

items.text: Assemble with them in spring and autumn to renew the compact, and do not absent yourself.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 각 도 향약 · 동계의 운영 실례
items.quote: 춘추강신(春秋講信) — spring/autumn meeting to reaffirm

items.text: Contribute your share to the common store for taxes, so that the village's obligations are met.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 각 도 향약 · 동계의 운영 실례
items.quote: 선공고는 전세 납부를 담당 — Seongonggo handled tax payment

items.text: Contribute to the storehouse for the relief of the poor and for funeral expenses, so that no one is left unaided.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 각 도 향약 · 동계의 운영 실례
items.quote: 휼빈고는 진휼과 상장(喪葬)을 담당 — Hyulbingo handled relief and funeral

items.text: Provide goods and labor to fellow members as the compact requires.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 각 도 향약 · 동계의 운영 실례
items.quote: 물품의 부조 내력, 노동력 제공 — provision of goods and labor

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 격몽요결 擊蒙要訣 … 참고문헌

items.text: Serve and care for them, and do not let filial duty slip from your mind even for a moment.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 격몽요결 擊蒙要訣
items.quote: 부모를 섬기고 — serve your parents

items.text: Respect and honor your elder brother.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 격몽요결 擊蒙要訣
items.quote: 형을 공경하며 — respect your elder brother

items.text: Obey and submit to your elders.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 격몽요결 擊蒙要訣
items.quote: 웃어른에게 순종하며 — obey your elders

items.text: When your parent dies, perform the funeral and mourning rites according to the Family Rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 격몽요결 擊蒙要訣
items.quote: 상례를 주희(朱熹)의 『가례』에 따를 것 — follow Zhu Xi's Family Rites in funeral rites

items.text: Set up a family shrine, enshrine the ancestral tablets, provide ritual fields and vessels, and observe the proper rites to the shrine.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 격몽요결 擊蒙要訣
items.quote: 사당을 세우고 조상의 신주를 모시며, 제전(祭田)을 두고 제기를 갖출 것 — set up a shrine, enshrine the ancestral tablets, provide ritual fields and vessels
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with the second commandment and Scripture's exclusive worship of God.

items.text: Maintain the proper etiquette between husband and wife in governing the household.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 격몽요결 擊蒙要訣
items.quote: 부부간의 예의를 중심으로 집안 다스리는 방법 — the method of managing the household centered on propriety between husband and wife

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 향약의 종류

items.text: Provide her the free labor of the village dure, farming her fields together with everyone else's.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 향약의 종류
items.quote: 과부나 병자, 노약자 등은 무상으로 하여 두레 공동노동의 사회보장적 혜택을 받았으니 — widows, the sick, the elderly, and the weak received the benefit of free communal labor.

items.text: Provide the aged the free labor of the village dure, farming their fields together with everyone else's.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 향약의 종류
items.quote: 과부나 병자, 노약자 등은 무상으로 하여 두레 공동노동의 사회보장적 혜택을 받았으니 — widows, the sick, the elderly, and the weak received the benefit of free communal labor.

items.text: Take responsibility for arranging the marriage of every grown daughter in the village.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 향약의 종류
items.quote: 과년한 처녀 총각의 혼사문제까지 주선하여 — even took care of the marriage problems of grown daughters and sons.

items.text: Take responsibility for arranging the marriage of every grown son in the village.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 향약 鄕約 · 향약 · 향약의 종류
items.quote: 과년한 처녀 총각의 혼사문제까지 주선하여 — even took care of the marriage problems of grown daughters and sons.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 동성동본불혼 同姓同本不婚 · 동성동본불혼 · 현황 … 참고문헌

items.text: Do not marry a blood relative of the same surname and ancestral seat.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 동성동본불혼 현황
items.quote: 동성동본인 혈족 사이에서는 혼인하지 못한다 — Marriage is forbidden between blood relatives of the same surname and ancestral seat.
items.conflict: Adds man-made restrictions on marriage beyond Scripture; caused social problems for distant relatives.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 내훈 內訓 · 내훈 · 내용

items.text: Serve your parents with right filial piety while they live.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, Naehun (content)
items.quote: 어버이에 대한 올바른 효도방법 — the right method of filial piety to parents.

items.text: Serve your husband's parents as your own parents.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, Naehun (content)
items.quote: 시가 부모를 모시는 법 — the way to serve one's husband's parents.

items.text: Practice filial piety after your parents' death, honoring them with mourning and remembrance.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, Naehun (content)
items.quote: 부모가 살아 있을 때와 죽은 뒤의 효도법 — how to be filial while parents are alive and after death.

items.text: Be courteous to your husband and keep a proper attitude toward him, fulfilling your wifely duty.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, Naehun (content)
items.quote: 남편에 대한 예의와 마음가짐 — courtesy and attitude toward husband.

items.text: Cultivate the four womanly virtues: virtue, speech, bearing, and work, rooted in benevolence.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, Naehun (content)
items.quote: 부덕·부언·부용·부공의 여유사행 — the four womanly conducts: womanly virtue, speech, appearance, and work.

items.text: Be careful in your speech, for words can make or break relationships and even ruin a nation.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, Naehun (content)
items.quote: 반드시 입을 조심하여야 — must be careful with the mouth.

items.text: Educate your children according to their age, and choose a wet nurse carefully.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, Naehun (content)
items.quote: 유모의 선택에서부터 자식의 연령에 따른 교육방법 — from selection of a wet nurse to age-appropriate education of children.

items.text: As mother-in-law, teach and guide your daughter-in-law in her duties.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, Naehun (content)
items.quote: 시어머니로서의 마음가짐과 며느리에 대한 교육 — mother-in-law's mindset and education of daughter-in-law.

items.text: Live harmoniously with your sisters-in-law.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, Naehun (content)
items.quote: 동서 또는 친척들과 화목하게 지내는 방법 — how to live harmoniously with sisters-in-law or relatives.

items.text: Live harmoniously with your relatives.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, Naehun (content)
items.quote: 친척들과 화목하게 지내는 방법 — how to live harmoniously with relatives.

items.text: Manage the household with integrity and frugality, and assist your husband in his official duties.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, Naehun (content)
items.quote: 청렴과 검소의 정신으로 어떻게 생활하고 손님을 대접하며, 관직에 있는 남편을 어떻게 보필할 것인가 — how to live with integrity and frugality, entertain guests, and assist husband in office.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture: articles on lineage, succession, kinship and fam
heading: 기제 忌祭 · 기제 · 절차 … 참고문헌

items.text: Purify yourself the day before the rite: bathe, change clothes, and keep away from mourning.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 기제 절차
items.quote: 하루 전부터 재계(齋戒)에 들어간다. — Enter purification from the day before.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the Second Commandment (Exod 20:4-5).

items.text: Clean the hall, set the table, and make ready the vessels and offerings the day before.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 기제 절차
items.quote: 정침을 청소하고 제사상을 설치하여 — Clean the hall and set the offering table.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the Second Commandment (Exod 20:4-5).

items.text: Dress in subdued dark clothes, and do not wear bright clothing, as for a death in the family.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 기제 절차
items.quote: 주인과 주부는 검푸른 계열의 옷을 착용하고 나머지 사람들은 화려한 옷을 입지 않도록 — The host and his wife wear dark blue clothes; the others do not wear showy clothes.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the Second Commandment (Exod 20:4-5).

items.text: Bring the spirit tablet from the shrine and set it in the hall.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 기제 절차
items.quote: 사당에 가서 신주를 받들어 정침으로 모시는 절차 — Go to the shrine, receive the spirit tablet, and bring it to the hall.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the Second Commandment (Exod 20:4-5).

items.text: Bow to the ancestor, offer incense, and pour a libation.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 기제 절차
items.quote: 분향과 뇌주로 구성된 ‘강신(降神)’ — gangsin, consisting of incense and a libation.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the Second Commandment (Exod 20:4-5).

items.text: Present the food: rice, soup, fish, meat, rice cakes, and noodles.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 기제 절차
items.quote: 밥, 국, 생선, 고기, 떡[米食], 만두나 국수[麵食] 등을 올린다 — offer rice, soup, fish, meat, rice cakes, and dumplings or noodles.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the Second Commandment (Exod 20:4-5).

items.text: Make the first offering of wine and grilled liver, and read the written prayer; weep if it is for your parents.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 기제 절차
items.quote: 술을 올린 뒤 ‘적간(炙肝)’이라고 해서 구운 간을 드리고, 독축(讀祝)을 진행한다 — offer wine, then present grilled liver and read the prayer.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the Second Commandment (Exod 20:4-5).

items.text: Make the second offering of wine and grilled meat.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 기제 절차
items.quote: ‘아헌(亞獻)’에서는 주부가 술을 올린 뒤 ‘적육(炙肉)’을 드리며 — In the second offering (aheon) the wife offers wine and then grilled meat.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the Second Commandment (Exod 20:4-5).

items.text: As the eldest brother of the host, make the third offering of wine and grilled meat.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 기제 절차
items.quote: ‘종헌(終獻)’은 주인의 형제 가운데 연장자 혹은 친척이나 손님이 수행하며 역시 ‘적육(炙肉)’을 올린다 — The final offering (jongheon) is performed by the eldest among the host's brothers, or a relative or guest, who also offers grilled meat.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the Second Commandment (Exod 20:4-5).

items.text: Fill the wine cup, close the door, and wait; after the cough, open the door again.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 기제 절차
items.quote: 주인이 주전자를 들고 제사상 앞으로 가서 술잔에 술을 가득 따르면 ... 문을 닫고 밖으로 나가서 기다리다가 — The host takes the kettle to the table and fills the cup full; then closes the door and goes out to wait.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the Second Commandment (Exod 20:4-5).

items.text: Stick the spoon into the rice with the handle toward the west and set the chopsticks straight.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 기제 절차
items.quote: 주부가 숟가락을 밥 가운데 꽂되 손잡이가 서쪽을 향하도록 한 뒤 젓가락을 바르게 정돈한다 — The wife sticks the spoon into the rice with the handle toward the west and arranges the chopsticks straight.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the Second Commandment (Exod 20:4-5).

items.text: Return the spirit tablet to the shrine.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Culture, 기제 절차
items.quote: 주인과 주부가 각기 신주를 받들어 사당에 다시 모시는 ‘납주(納主)’ — The host and wife each take the spirit tablet back to the shrine (napju).
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the Second Commandment (Exod 20:4-5).
